```{r setup environment, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(yaml)
library(xml2)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  echo = FALSE,
  include = TRUE
)

is_blank <- function(x) {
  is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x)) || !nzchar(trimws(as.character(x[1])))
}

as_flag <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(isTRUE(x))
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(!is.na(x[1]) && x[1] != 0)
  if (is.character(x)) return(tolower(trimws(x[1])) %in% c("true", "t", "1", "y", "yes"))
  FALSE
}

normalize_vec <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(character(0))
  unique(as.character(unlist(x)))
}

ensure_dir <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

stop_missing <- function(name) stop("Missing required config field: ", name)

ensure_xml_param <- function(parameters, name) {
  node <- xml_find_first(parameters, paste0("//parameter[@name='", name, "']"))
  if (inherits(node, "xml_missing")) {
    stop("Cannot find parameter node in mzMine XML: ", name)
  }
  node
}

run_mzmine <- function(path_mzmine, mzmine_user, param_file, path_output, mzmine_memory, mzmine_threads, path_temp) {
  mem_args <- strsplit(trimws(as.character(mzmine_memory)), "\\s+")[[1]]
  th_args <- strsplit(trimws(as.character(mzmine_threads)), "\\s+")[[1]]
  mem_args <- mem_args[nzchar(mem_args)]
  th_args <- th_args[nzchar(th_args)]

  args <- c(
    "-user", mzmine_user,
    "-batch", param_file,
    "-output", path_output,
    mem_args,
    th_args,
    "-temp", path_temp
  )
  
  if (grepl("/wd", path_mzmine)) {
    fs::dir_copy("/wd/mzmine_linux/external_tools", paste0(path_temp, "/external_tools"), overwrite = TRUE)
  }

  status <- system2(path_mzmine, args = args)
  if (!identical(status, 0L)) {
    stop("mzMine execution failed with exit code: ", status)
  }
}

```

```{r pipeline input}

if (is_blank(params$config)) {
  stop("params$config is required")
}
if (!file.exists(params$config)) {
  stop("Config file does not exist: ", params$config)
}

config <- read_yaml(params$config)

if (is.null(config) || !is.list(config)) {
  stop("Invalid YAML config: expected a named list")
}

path_raw = config$path_raw
path_result = config$path_result
path_mzmine = config$path_mzmine
path_temp = config$path_temp

method_name = config$method_name
analysis <- stringr::str_split_i(method_name, "_", 3)
run.pos = as_flag(config$run.pos)
raw_files_pos = normalize_vec(config$raw_files_pos)
run.neg = as_flag(config$run.neg)
raw_files_neg = normalize_vec(config$raw_files_neg)
mzmine_params = config$mzmine_params 
# path_lib_pos = config$path_lib_pos
# path_lib_neg = config$path_lib_neg
path_lib_istd_pos = config$path_lib_istd_pos
path_lib_istd_neg = config$path_lib_istd_neg
path_spectral_lib = config$path_spectral_lib
path_spectral_lib <- normalize_vec(path_spectral_lib)
path_spectral_lib <- path_spectral_lib[!is.na(path_spectral_lib)]
path_spectral_lib <- path_spectral_lib[nzchar(path_spectral_lib)]
path_spectral_lib <- path_spectral_lib[!grepl("/wdNA|^NA$", path_spectral_lib)]
mzmine_user = config$mzmine_user
mzmine_memory <- config$mzmine_memory
mzmine_threads <- config$mzmine_threads
# output
mzmine_peaktable_pos <- config$mzmine_peaktable_pos
mzmine_peaktable_neg <- config$mzmine_peaktable_neg

if (is_blank(path_result)) stop_missing("path_result")
if (is_blank(path_temp)) stop_missing("path_temp")
if (is_blank(mzmine_params)) stop_missing("mzmine_params")
if (is_blank(path_mzmine)) stop_missing("path_mzmine")
if (is_blank(mzmine_user)) stop_missing("mzmine_user")

path_result <- normalizePath(path_result, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
path_temp <- normalizePath(path_temp, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
mzmine_params <- normalizePath(mzmine_params, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(mzmine_params)) {
  stop("mzmine_params file not found: ", mzmine_params)
}
if (grepl("[/\\\\]", path_mzmine) && !file.exists(path_mzmine)) {
  stop("path_mzmine executable not found: ", path_mzmine)
}

ensure_dir(path_result)
ensure_dir(path_temp)
```

## Method configuration
```{r}

cat("Method name: ", method_name, "\n")
cat("In house libraries used for preprocessing: \n")
if (!is.na(path_lib_istd_pos)) cat(path_lib_istd_pos, "\n")
if (!is.na(path_lib_istd_neg)) cat(path_lib_istd_neg, "\n")
cat("Spectral libraries used for preprocessing: \n")
cat(path_spectral_lib, "\n")
cat("mzmine parameter file used for preprocessing: \n")
cat(mzmine_params, "\n")
```

## Raw data files
```{r}

cat("Raw data for preprocessing are stored in: \n")
cat(path_raw, "\n")

```

## Preprocessing
```{r}

if (!dir.exists(path_result)) dir.create(path_result)

```

### Positive
```{r, eval = run.pos}

path_output <- paste0(path_result, "/pos")
ensure_dir(path_output)
cat("Processed data in positive mode is stored in: \n")
cat(path_output, "\n")

raw_files <- raw_files_pos
if (length(raw_files) == 0) stop("run.pos=TRUE but no positive raw files are defined")
# path_lib <- list(path_lib_istd_pos, path_lib_pos)
# path_lib <- path_lib[!is.na(path_lib)]
path_lib <- path_lib_istd_pos
parameters <- ifelse(grepl("OPS", analysis), 
                     read_xml(gsub(".mzbatch", "_pos.mzbatch", mzmine_params)),
                     read_xml(mzmine_params))
param_file <- paste0(path_output, "/mzmine_parameters_pos.mzbatch")

if (!file.exists(param_file)){
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "File names")
  new_files <- raw_files
  
  for (f in new_files) {
    xml_add_child(file_names_node, "file", f)
  }
  
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "Database file")
  
  if (!is_blank(path_lib) && !is.na(path_lib) && file.exists(path_lib)) {
    xml_add_child(file_names_node, "current_file", path_lib)
  }
  
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "Spectral library files")
  
  for (f in path_spectral_lib) {
    if (!is.na(f) && file.exists(f)) xml_add_child(file_names_node, "file", f)
  }
  
  write_xml(parameters, param_file)
}

if (!file.exists(mzmine_peaktable_pos)){
  run_mzmine(path_mzmine, mzmine_user, param_file, path_output, mzmine_memory, mzmine_threads, path_temp)
} else {
  cat('raw pos is already preprocessed, skipped this step.')
}

```

### Negative
```{r, eval = run.neg}

path_output <- paste0(path_result, "/neg")
ensure_dir(path_output)
cat("Processed data in negative mode is stored in: \n")
cat(path_output, "\n")

raw_files <- raw_files_neg
if (length(raw_files) == 0) stop("run.neg=TRUE but no negative raw files are defined")
# path_lib <- list(path_lib_istd_neg, path_lib_neg)
# path_lib <- path_lib[!is.na(path_lib)]
path_lib <- path_lib_istd_neg
parameters <- ifelse(grepl("OPS", analysis), 
                     read_xml(gsub(".mzbatch", "_neg.mzbatch", mzmine_params)),
                     read_xml(mzmine_params))
param_file <- paste0(path_output, "/mzmine_parameters_neg.mzbatch")

if (!file.exists(param_file)){
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "File names")
  new_files <- raw_files
  
  for (f in new_files) {
    xml_add_child(file_names_node, "file", f)
  }
  
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "Database file")
  
  if (!is_blank(path_lib) && !is.na(path_lib) && file.exists(path_lib)) {
    xml_add_child(file_names_node, "current_file", path_lib)
  }
  
  file_names_node <- ensure_xml_param(parameters, "Spectral library files")
  
  for (f in path_spectral_lib) {
    if (!is.na(f) && file.exists(f)) xml_add_child(file_names_node, "file", f)
  }
    
  write_xml(parameters, param_file)
}

if (!file.exists(mzmine_peaktable_neg)){
  run_mzmine(path_mzmine, mzmine_user, param_file, path_output, mzmine_memory, mzmine_threads, path_temp)
} else {
  cat('raw neg is already preprocessed, skipped this step.')
}
```
